en-US.author: DBeaver Corp
en-US.longDescription:
DBeaver is free and open source universal database tool for developers and database administrators.
- Usability is the main goal of this project, program UI is carefully designed and implemented.
- It is free and open-source (ASL).
- It is multiplatform.
- It is based on opensource framework and allows writing of various extensions (plugins).
- It supports any database having a JDBC driver.
- It may handle any external datasource which may or may not have a JDBC driver.
- There is a set of plugins for different databases and different database management utilities (e.g. ERD, data transfer, compare, data export/import, mock data generation, etc).
- It has a great number of features.
en-US.name: DBeaver
en-US.releaseNotes:
- AI Assistant:
    - Added drag-and-drop support for Navigator objects and files in AI Chat
    - Added support for attaching images to AI Chat from files, drag-and-drop, and the clipboard
    - Fixed an issue where closing multiple SQL Editor tabs cleared the selected AI Chat connection and conversation
    - Fixed SQL block Execute, Copy, and Open in editor actions on Linux (thanks to @Josephur)
    - Fixed small font sizes and unnecessary truncation for profile and model names in AI Chat
    - ChatGPT subscription errors are now displayed as readable messages instead of raw JSON
- SQL Editor:
    - Added the ability to execute SQL script files without opening them in the SQL Editor
    - Added a notification for refreshing affected metadata after successful DDL execution
    - Fixed an issue where new SQL templates used Vertica instead of abstract SQL as the default context
    - Fixed SQL Editor corruption when deleting an auto-inserted closing bracket in Eclipse installations with TM4E (thanks to @RoiSoleil)
- Metadata Editor:
    - Fixed checkbox backgrounds in the table column dialog on macOS in dark mode
- Data Editor:
    - Fixed Adaptive Ordering for large numeric values
    - Fixed row order when dragging multiple selected result-set rows into the SQL Editor (thanks to @Abdulrahman295)
- Data transfer:
    - Redesigned the extraction settings page
    - Redesigned the export target page with in-wizard source management
- Connectivity:
    - Improved error messages for invalid SSH known-hosts files with the affected file path and corrective guidance
    - Fixed empty credential dialogs for integrated authentication methods
    - Fixed an issue where connection settings could be cut off and could not be scrolled after changing authentication options
- Security:
    - Fixed a command execution vulnerability by requiring confirmation before running shell commands used to retrieve connection passwords (CWE-78, CWE-306)
    - Fixed high, medium, and low vulnerabilities in the lz4-java library used by the ClickHouse and Databricks drivers (CVE-2026-106451, CVE-2026-106450, and CVE-2026-106449). The library was updated to version 1.11.4.
- Product configuration:
    - Git integration is now enabled by default when existing Git projects are detected
    - The SQLite sample database is now enabled by default
- New drivers:
    - Added support for YashanDB (thanks to @YoungQinger9)
- Databases:
    - Clickhouse: Added the ability to rename tables from the Navigator tree.
    - CUBRID: Fixed extra quoting around hexadecimal default values in generated DDL (thanks to @longhaseng52)
    - MySQL: Restored bold highlighting for catalogs and tables with granted privileges
    - Oracle: User profiles now show their assigned users
    - PostgreSQL:
        - Fixed bulk imports that mishandled literal backslashes or custom CSV escape characters
        - Fixed SQL formatting for the @? operator (thanks to @SemTiOne)
    - SQL Server:
        - Fixed missing quotes around datetimeoffset values when copying multiple cells or rows as SQL
        - Non-online databases are now marked in Navigator, and their status is shown in the Databases tab (thanks to @michalpsyk)
- Localization:
    - Added Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) localization

zh-CN.longDescription:
DBeaver 是一款面向开发者和数据库管理员的免费开源通用数据库工具。
- 易用性是该项目的核心目标，软件界面经过精心设计与实现。
- 采用免费开源协议（ASL）。
- 支持跨平台运行。
- 基于开源框架开发，可编写多样化扩展功能（插件）。
- 兼容所有配备 JDBC 驱动的数据库。
- 可处理任意外部数据源（无论是否具备 JDBC 驱动）。
- 提供针对不同数据库的插件集及多样化数据库管理功能（如 ER 图、数据传输、结构对比、数据导入/导出、模拟数据生成等）。
- 具备丰富的功能特性。
